ValidationRule.description: R-PM11: submitted entries change only by the project owner or Projects Admin, approved ones only by Projects Admin.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Approved"), NOT($Permission.Projects_Manage), OR(ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(Hours__c), ISCHANGED(Date__c), ISCHANGED(User__c), ISCHANGED(Task__c), ISCHANGED(Billable__c), AND(ISCHANGED(Bill_Rate__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Bill_Rate__c)))), AND(ISCHANGED(Cost_Rate__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Cost_Rate__c)))))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Submitted"), Project__r.OwnerId <> $User.Id, NOT($Permission.Projects_Manage), OR(ISCHANGED(Hours__c), ISCHANGED(Date__c), ISCHANGED(User__c), ISCHANGED(Task__c), ISCHANGED(Billable__c), AND(ISCHANGED(Bill_Rate__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Bill_Rate__c)))), AND(ISCHANGED(Cost_Rate__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Cost_Rate__c))))))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These hours are locked: recall submitted hours to change them, or ask a Projects admin to change approved hours.
